title: Certified local firms beside a much larger or out-of-State firm
question: Which certified local firms are registered at the same suite as, or are in a recorded owner-group with, a much larger uncertified City payee or a firm registered only outside California?
finding: 14 pairings of a directory firm with a larger or out-of-State firm: 12 without a recorded participation-credit restriction between them (1 through an owner-group on record evidence, the rest by a shared registry address). The largest undeclared: Urban West Construction Inc. beside Ranger Pipelines Inc. ($128.7 million; in one owner-group (the “aliases” analysis, evidence tier 2)).
how: Each directory firm's business address is looked up in the Treasurer's registry of business locations (suite-level; addresses with more than 4 owners at the suite, or 8 at a street address with no suite, and mail-drop names are ignored, as in the “aliases” analysis), and its name in the owner-groups of the “aliases groups” results (tiers 1 to 4: common owner account, licensed person or filing). The other firm is listed when it is not in the directory and was paid at least $5.0 million and 5 times as much as the certified firm since fiscal 2019, or when the registry places it only outside California and it is a City payee or contractor.
limits: Sharing an address with a large firm is common for subtenants, joint ventures and shared yards. Owner-groups rest on the records listed in the site’s “One owner behind several names” page; an address-only pairing is a lead. The size and ownership limits of certification are not in any file on disk. "Registered only outside California" refers to the registry's location rows for that name, which can be a branch.
